source: NOAA NHC GIS (KMZ) + Tropical Weather Outlook

outlook.discussion: 1. South of Guatemala: An area of low pressure is forecast to form south of the coast of Guatemala early next week. Environmental conditions are expected to be conducive for gradual development thereafter, and a tropical depression is likely to form by late next week as the system moves generally west-northwestward at around 10 mph. Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...high...70 percent.
